units.evidence: Official welcome names Operations Research Department; faculty directory explicitly covers production planning, global operations, supply-chain management and humanitarian logistics.

sources.note: Full department name and OR research mission.

Full substantive official department home page individually opened and read through primary web full-page text. Exact Department of Acquisition, Finance, and Manpower title and NPS identity; chair message says organization launched in 2022 replacing Graduate School of Business and Public Policy, changes for new classes in 2023. Fields/themes do not rename department. No person employment histories or contact details recorded.

Full official institutional catalogue department page read through primary web full-page text. Actual department title; Acquisition Sciences group, Financial Management and Manpower and Economics areas; twelve-department catalogue navigation separately names Operations Research. AFM actual programme list masters/certificates, not a department named Operations/Management Science/IE. No negative whole-university doctorate inference.

25 October official primary web follow-up verifies Department of Acquisition, Finance, and Manpower as an actual distinct NPS department. Its title does not meet the named Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering unit rule; explicit standalone Operations Research Department remains separately recorded. The source faculty vacancy body was not read, and no individual faculty/job-history or doctorate conclusion is inferred from the source assertion.

branches.conclusion: Entire current programmes-of-study inventory checked; professional MBA, finance/acquisition/logistics and management curricula do not establish a separate business doctorate. OR doctoral route captured under actual OR host.

Full current inventory plus detailed OR, Systems Engineering, Applied Mathematics and MOVES doctorates checked. Explicit OR PhD qualifies. Other generic modelling/math/systems or training simulation descriptions do not establish additional qualifying Ops/IE specialization.

sources.note: Current OR department programme page explicitly offers Doctor of Philosophy in Operations Research under programme title Operations Analysis, Curriculum 382; optimization/statistics/stochastic exams and dissertation.

Current linked catalogue confirms exact Operations Analysis PhD Curriculum 382 under Department Operations Research, exact award Doctor of Philosophy in Operations Research, doctoral committee, dissertation, ordinary three-year postmaster’s residency and Fall/Spring intake.

Entire current Programs of Study alphabetical inventory read, all doctorates/master’s/certificates. Business/acquisition/finance/logistics options separate from OR doctoral route; no business PhD title in inventory. Delivery modes and certificates not counted as separate degrees.

Actual Systems Engineering PhD curriculum 581/582 read: systems-engineering processes/applications, systems modelling/simulation and suitability assessment; generic systems scope not classified as IE/OR. Resident/distance modes same award.

Actual MOVES PhD curriculum 398 read: visual simulation, combat modelling/analysis, networked simulation, agents/cognitive modelling, training systems/human factors and discrete-event simulation. Actual PhD/dissertation verified, but opened description does not establish qualifying production/IE or OR specialization; not added solely for simulation/human-factors method words.
Actual Applied Mathematics PhD curriculum 381 read. Specializations determined case-by-case, no explicit OR specialization mapped; broad mathematics not treated as qualifying route.

limitations: Current source-bounded inventory scope, not historical doctorate census.
